retrievalProfile.description: A low-angle triumphant sports composition featuring a central athlete with raised arms against a misty, atmospheric background.
excludeWhen: bright sunny outdoor lighting is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A central hockey player in a white jersey with arms raised in victory, positioned low in the frame. The background is a dark, misty blue with a faint vertical flag motif. High-contrast white serif typography anchors the bottom of the composition.
coreVisualRelationships: The athlete's raised arms create a V-shape that leads the eye to the top of the frame.
The dark blue background provides high contrast for the white jersey and white typography.
The low-angle perspective emphasizes the scale and heroic nature of the subject.
The misty texture bridges the gap between the sharp foreground subject and the soft background elements.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The athlete is centered in the lower-middle ground, scaled to dominate the horizontal center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large-scale title text at the bottom serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the large title, moves up the athlete's body to the raised arms, and finally to the secondary text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark negative space on the left and right sides focuses attention on the central action.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red and blue accents (jersey details and flag motif)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the background with high value contrast between the subject and the surroundings.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid warm tones like yellow or orange

letterConstructionRules: Wide proportions for the main title
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'M' and 'A' in the title feature sharp apexes to mirror the upward movement of the athlete's arms.

composition.relationshipToImage: anchors the base of the subject
floats in the upper negative space

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Use a high-contrast display serif for the title and a more legible, wider-tracked version of the same family for metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic cinematic serif with high authority and historical weight.
Modern alternative with sharp serifs and a heroic feel.
Traditional transitional serif with high contrast for a classic look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic image of a hockey player in a white jersey with arms raised in victory, low-angle shot, dark blue misty ice rink background with faint vertical stripes suggesting a flag, dramatic lighting from above.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large white uppercase serif text centered at the bottom. Add smaller, wide-tracked white uppercase serif text at the very top and below the main title.

verificationChecks: Is the athlete centered and low in the frame?
Is the color palette dominated by deep blues and whites?
Is the main title in a high-contrast serif font?
Is there a misty, atmospheric texture throughout the background?

adjustableVariables: Saturation of the red accents on the jersey
Height of the athlete within the frame
mustRedesign: Any specific team logos or trademarked branding
Exact facial features of the athlete

mustAchieve: Atmospheric depth through lighting and mist

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is perfectly centered horizontally.
Check that the athlete's arms do not overlap the top text.
Verify the blue tones are deep and not overly vibrant.
Confirm the serif font looks 'cinematic' and 'authoritative'.
recipe.reuseFormula: Heroic Athlete + Low Angle + Misty Blue Atmosphere + Wide-Tracked Serif Typography = Triumphant Sports Key Art
